## What this profile is

- Public repos are runnable evidence; in-house and client systems are described in desensitised terms only

## Strengths claimed (from profile text)

- End-to-end delivery: process discovery → diagnosis → design → platform customisation → integration → acceptance → review
- Owns the whole line solo: API and schema design, React front end, Docker deployment, production debugging
- Agent workflows, tool calling, structured output (JSON Schema), MCP and RAG as integration work rather than research
- Full-text + vector hybrid retrieval, score fusion, rerank, near-duplicate dedup
- Async job pipelines: idempotency keys, retries, human handoff, rollback paths, structured logs, cost per call
- Ships a 1–2 week usable version first, then hardens; hands over with runbook, acceptance checklist and deploy scripts

## Representative public projects

- IDM-Activation-Script-Chinese — Windows batch toolkit, GBK menus, registry backup, no binary patching
- PromptPanel — macOS prompt/snippet launcher (Swift/SwiftUI), local-first, full release/CI/test loop
- cleanplate — local-first AI video watermark removal backend (FastAPI + ComfyUI DiffuEraser, FFmpeg fallback)
- bilibili-cleaner — bulk account cleanup (FastAPI + Web UI + CLI + Docker), review gates and rate limits
- x-account-cleaner — X/Twitter cleanup CLI (TypeScript + Playwright), review-first irreversible actions
- telegram-ui-builder — visual designer for bot messages, inline keyboards, multi-screen flows (deployed demo)
- macfriends-cli — WeChat relationship inspection on macOS (Rust + ObjC++ agent), strictly local
- bazi-master — full-stack AI divination web app (React + Express + PostgreSQL + Prisma)

## How to evaluate

- Prefer reading the public repos and their README/runbooks over claims alone
- Star counts are not written into the prose; read them from the repo pages or the generated assets
- Assets on the profile are generated by scripts/gen_assets.py from the GitHub API and refreshed weekly by CI
- Numbers quoted for in-house work (cost per call, latency, failure distribution) are internal sample /
  pilot statistics traceable to run records, not external benchmarks
